project_info.theme: Partner-brand opening voucher with athlete and dense product collage
project_info.color_palette: Near Black, Ultimate Sup Yellow, Olive Green, White, Charcoal

main_subject.detail: A black-and-yellow square partner-sale poster featuring REF_ULTIMATESUP_LOGO plus REF_PARTNER_LOGO, oversized {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}}, a muscular REF_ATHLETE_MODEL on the right, and a broad lineup of REF_PARTNER_PRODUCTS across the lower half.
main_subject.style: Hardcore performance-supplement poster, high contrast, premium cutout packshots, assertive masculine sports editorial

composition_elements.type: Partner logos / athlete / product lineup / value ribbon
composition_elements.text: Use {{EVENT_HEADLINE}}, {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}}, {{SAVE_COPY}}, {{CREDIBILITY_POINTS}}, and {{CTA}}. All commercial terms require current approval.
items: Left/Middle: Oversized yellow {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}} with white OFF text and {{SAVE_COPY}}.
Right: REF_ATHLETE_MODEL cropped from chest to waist, facing toward the copy.
Lower: REF_PARTNER_PRODUCTS as a dense but legible assortment arranged over yellow/olive geometric panels.
Bottom: Yellow credibility ribbon with {{CREDIBILITY_POINTS}}, then black CTA bar.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Dark premium background, clean rim light on athlete, glossy packshot highlights, strong yellow sale contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup x partner-brand opening-voucher poster. Preserve a black background with yellow/olive geometric panels, logos at top, {{EVENT_HEADLINE}}, huge {{DISCOUNT_VALUE}} OFF left, REF_ATHLETE_MODEL on the right, a broad lower collage of REF_PARTNER_PRODUCTS, a yellow credibility ribbon with {{CREDIBILITY_POINTS}}, and {{CTA}} in a black bottom bar. Keep all pack labels, logos, and commercial copy accurate.
prompt.negative_prompt: incorrect partner logo, unapproved athlete, distorted supplement tub, invented certification, unsupported quality claim, unreadable discount, low contrast, watermark, cropped CTA
